title: The Craziest Chess World Records
post: The craziest Guinness World Records in chess: a 20-foot king, 604 games at once, 64 hours in Times Square and 48 blindfold games on an exercise bike. #chess #guinnessworldrecords #worldrecord #chesstok

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Someone played chess for 64 hours straight.
phrases.say: [excited] Someone played chess for sixty-four hours straight.

phrases.text: Number five. Setting up a whole chess board in 29.85 seconds. With one hand.
phrases.say: Number five. Setting up a whole chess board... in twenty-nine point eight five seconds. With one hand.

phrases.text: Number four. The biggest chess piece ever made. A king, 20 feet tall. Almost 11,000 pounds.
phrases.say: Number four. The biggest chess piece ever made. A king... twenty feet tall. Almost eleven thousand pounds.

phrases.text: Number three. One grandmaster played 604 people at once. Over 25 hours. He lost only eight games.
phrases.say: Number three. One grandmaster played six hundred and four people at once. Over twenty-five hours. He lost only eight games.

phrases.text: But Guinness only counted 135 of them.
phrases.say: [laughs] But Guinness only counted a hundred thirty-five of them.

phrases.text: Number two. Two players in Times Square. 64 hours. 473 games.
phrases.say: Number two. Two players in Times Square. Sixty-four hours. Four hundred seventy-three games.

phrases.text: Number one. Timur Gareyev played 48 games at the same time. Blindfolded. While riding an exercise bike.
phrases.say: [impressed] Number one. Timur Gareyev played forty-eight games at the same time... blindfolded... while riding an exercise bike.

phrases.text: Which one would you try? Follow for more.
phrases.say: [playful] Which one would you try? Follow for more.
